model_parameterization.official_time_conventions: Paper tau can be clean fraction; official manipulation t is noise fraction. sigma=1−tau maps full Uniform to full Uniform; compare conventions before judging coverage.
model_parameterization.World_IL: Clean-x head trained with shift5 sigma and clean-x L1, not a direct velocity-MSE head.
model_parameterization.World_FPO: On straight CFM interpolation x_sigma=(1−sigma)*a+sigma*eps, v=(x_sigma−pred_x0)/sigma, target=eps−a.
model_parameterization.exact_reweighting: v−target=(a−pred_x0)/sigma; squared velocity error = squared clean-x error /sigma². Energy sums8poses and means3coords.
model_parameterization.implication: Widening sigma also redistributes effective clean-x-error weighting. It is one config-factor change, not pure coverage with fixed effective gradient scale.
model_parameterization.still_not_full_paper: Min sigma stays.2; current per-MC ordinary PPO lacks FPO++ASPO and its optional loss clamps, and usesM2. No exact endpoint likelihood/IS/ELBO-equivalence claim.
model_parameterization.head_bucket: High sigma maps to early denoising bucket (1−sigma)*1000; sigma1 gives legal bucket0, no new action-input field.

evidence_interpretation.samebaseline_replication: TRAIN and NAV fixed ILhigh both favor FPO over Safety1k. NAV ILlow loss/TTC degradation does NOT reproduce on TRAIN1024; TRAIN ILlow favors FPO.
evidence_interpretation.TRAIN: All1024 matched FPO/Safety NC,DAC,TTC,Comfort are equal; improvement is EP-only, fixed zeros6 unchanged. TRAIN diagnostic is not an independent heldout population.
evidence_interpretation.NAV: Fixed ILlow3422 contributes the loss: PDMS−1.24426 and TTC−1.57802pp versusSafety, whereas high8724 gainsPDMS+.32098.
evidence_interpretation.causal_limit: Time support gap is exact engineering evidence, but neither the 1k cohort association nor the grid count proves it caused low-cohort degradation. No per-time deployment error was measured here.

conclusions_zh: 时间支持缺口确实存在：原CFM sigma[.2,.8)只覆盖10个ODE节点中的4个；新上界1.0补齐其余高噪声区间，但MC不保证精确命中节点，sigma1只是边界。
min.2不变，所以不会新增近零sigma除法风险；同时共同区间采样密度降25%，新高sigma占25%，有效clean-x平方误差权重分布也改变。
同基线FPO1k−Safety1k：NAV高分组+.321、低分组−1.244；TRAIN高分组+.104、低分组+.106。高分获益部分复现，NAV低分/TTC退化未在TRAIN复现。
值得以同IL70 fresh、只改sigma_max的1k/5k有限对照检验；时间覆盖不等于退化原因证明，也不能称本实现为完整FPO++。
